title: CutRight v2 evidence graph (v1)
description: Top-level evidence graph for a project revision. Bundles nodes, edges, and revisions the graph was built against. The graph is content-addressed; the `graph_hash` is the BLAKE3 hash of the canonicalised graph body.

project_revision.description: Project revision this graph was built for.

source_revisions.description: Every source revision that contributed at least one node.

graph_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the canonicalised graph body (nodes and edges sorted by id).

frozen.description: True iff the graph is read-only; mutations must produce a new graph.
